nodes.label: Phases (build plan)
nodes.rationale: 28 Sep 2026 to 20 Mar 2027: 11 phases in 25 weeks plus a parallel research track.

nodes.label: Phase Exit Check and Advisor Demo
nodes.rationale: Each phase ends with an advisor demo and a written exit check; a phase does not close until its exit criteria pass.

nodes.label: FYP-1 / FYP-2 Evaluation Dates (unconfirmed)
nodes.rationale: When dates arrive, move the nearest phase demo onto the evaluation date.

nodes.label: P0 Docs, Brand, Repo (28 Sep-4 Oct)
nodes.rationale: Goal: everyone builds from the same plan.

nodes.label: P1 Foundation (5-18 Oct)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a person can sign up into the right world and nothing leaks between worlds.

nodes.label: P2 Screening Engine (19 Oct-8 Nov)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a patient completes a PHQ-9 with rephrased questions and gets a correct, explained result.

nodes.label: P3 Safety Hard Stop (9-19 Nov)
nodes.rationale: Goal: no crisis signal slips through, and the patient always reaches help.

nodes.label: P4 Counselor and Profiler (20 Nov-6 Dec)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a patient can talk, and the system remembers what matters without drifting.

nodes.label: P5 Scholar (7-27 Dec)
nodes.rationale: Goal: students get cited answers or an honest refusal.

nodes.label: P6 Psychologist Module (28 Dec-13 Jan)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a psychologist trusts a flag because they can see exactly why it exists.

nodes.label: P7 Speech Engine (14-27 Jan)
nodes.rationale: Goal: voice clips produce reliable acoustic markers.

nodes.label: P8 Vision Engine (28 Jan-17 Feb)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a normal webcam yields blink and gaze metrics good enough to report with confidence levels.

nodes.label: P9 Fusion, Reports, Fine-tune (18 Feb-6 Mar)
nodes.rationale: Goal: one report brings answers, words and behaviour together; and we know whether our own model beats the API.

nodes.label: P10 Validation, Deploy, Defence (7-20 Mar)
nodes.rationale: Goal: a defensible system and thesis.

nodes.label: Post-FYP Roadmap (marketplace, Urdu UI, adolescent instruments, mobile)
FastAPI Skeleton and Alembic Baseline (five schemas)
DB Roles and Row-Level Security
nodes.rationale: Isolation between patient, scholar and clinician worlds is enforced in the database, proven by an integration test that the scholar role cannot select from patient.*.

nodes.label: Audit Log with Hash Chain
nodes.rationale: Hash chain makes the audit log tamper-evident; UPDATE on audit.events fails.

nodes.label: Rephrase + Equivalence Pipeline with Cache
nodes.rationale: Rephrased items below equivalence 0.85 fall back to canonical wording; rephrase:false items stay canonical.

nodes.label: Crisis Lexicon v1 (English + Roman Urdu, normaliser)
Golden Crisis and Benign Eval Sets
nodes.rationale: Targets: recall 100% on golden set, false positives under 5% on benign set.

nodes.label: Output Guard Library
nodes.rationale: Blocks diagnosis labels, medication dosing and certainty claims in AI output.

nodes.label: LLM Gateway (provider interface)
nodes.rationale: Tracker T-4.01: Anthropic + OpenRouter providers, cost limits, PII scrub.

nodes.label: Counselor Prompt v1 (CBT, MI, psychosis neutrality)
Research Capture Kit v0 (consent flow + recorder)
nodes.rationale: Built in P4 so consented data collection can start in January.

nodes.label: Acoustic Features (pause, rate, filler, pitch, jitter, shimmer)
MediaPipe Face Landmarker in Web Worker
EAR Blink Detection, Iris Gaze, Fixations, Head Pose
Research Vision Pipeline (YOLO v12 face, ViT gaze)
Fusion Summary in Clinical Export
nodes.rationale: Markers shown beside scores with ranges and quality.

nodes.label: Fine-tuned vs API Benchmark
nodes.rationale: The better model per task is selected by config.
